models.jsonl.note: the answer to initialize without a prompt: commands, agents and output styles dropped, the account replaced; haiku has no auto mode and no effort

denied.jsonl.note: a deny rule on the file a Bash cat reads

nologin.jsonl.note: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR pointed at an empty folder

subagent.jsonl.note: real Agent tool stream plus one sub-agent assistant line

background_agents.jsonl.note: --model haiku, three Agent calls with run_in_background, stdin closed on the first result: each finished agent wakes the session for one more result, the last is gamma; skills and paths of the init lines dropped

error.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl ending in an error result

empty_result.jsonl.note: --json-schema wrapped as {result: schema | null}; the model had nothing to do

no_session.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl whose result has no session id

selfcheck.jsonl.note: auto-mode self-check turn: Bash echo into word.txt without asking, Read of a hidden file refused, AskUserQuestion through approve, then StructuredOutput

selfcheck_resume.jsonl.note: auto-mode self-check resume: the same word and answer from the session

selfcheck_nousage.jsonl.note: selfcheck.jsonl whose result has no usage

selfcheck_resume_nousage.jsonl.note: selfcheck_resume.jsonl whose result has no usage

selfcheck_nodenial.jsonl.note: selfcheck.jsonl whose result has no permission denials

selfcheck_offline.jsonl.note: self-check turn without network: curl in the sandbox of the CLI prints 000

background.jsonl.note: ok.jsonl with a background task: the turn ends with a result, the finished task wakes the session and a second result follows, as 2.1.281 does for a sleep it moved to the background

background_agent.jsonl.note: background.jsonl with an Agent tool run in the background: task_started, then an empty result while the task still runs
